note_lr: Peak 3e-5, warmup 100, floor 5e-6 as r4/r5. Cosine spans the fixed 2400-update horizon, so rungs 300/900/2400 are prefixes of one trajectory. A resume without Adam state re-warms over 100 updates.
note_ema: Decay .99 instead of r5's .999: at .999 a 300-update EMA is close to a flat mean of the whole rung, including the first post-surgery updates.
note_weights: Inverse-sqrt of the loss-weighted train mix (reports/evolve-20261104/type-mix.json), mean 1 over kind tokens. See TYPE_COLLAPSE.md. Read at kind T .3 and 1.0.
note_objective: Every fine-tune so far ran 25-2,400 updates at 3e-5 and moved numbers by small trade-offs. One long run from r5: 12,000 updates at 6e-5, same recipe. Target: single-sample CER nearest .557/.553 -> <= .50 or product better by .02 in both modes on SCREEN-60 and RANDOM-100; guards F1@20 -.01, request path not worse.
